comments.text: The taxi cab scene in Deadpool is pure gold! The way he goes off on the driver about Ferris Bueller still cracks me up every time. That was 100% Ryan just being Ryan! 😂

replies.text: Yes! The "I'm gonna need you to take me to the airport… right now" line was so ad-libbed. The driver's reaction is priceless too!

comments.text: Don't forget the Aviation Gin and Peloton jokes! Ryan's real-life sponsorships making their way into the script is genius marketing and hilarious. Only Ryan can pull that off so naturally.

replies.text: The Peloton one had me rolling! "You paid how much for that bike?!" 😂
Aviation Gin in the background of so many scenes is such a subtle flex. Love it.

comments.text: Ryan as a dad is my favorite role. The way he talks about his girls is so heartwarming. Makes me love him even more. ❤️

replies.text: 100%! His interviews about fatherhood are the best. So genuine and down-to-earth.

comments.text: Ryan's Twitter presence is unmatched. The birthday wishes, the random replies, the humor… he actually engages with fans. Legend.

replies.text: He replied to my tweet once and I genuinely screamed. Still have the notification screenshotted somewhere.
